components.name: Button
components.summary: A button, or a link that looks like one when it has an `href`.

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.summary: Buttons joined together. It needs a label, because a group is a landmark for assistive technology.

components.name: Toggle
components.summary: A two-state button. It is a checkbox underneath, so it posts with its form, keeps its state with no script and has the keyboard of a checkbox.

components.name: Field
components.summary: A control with its label, help and error, tied together with `for`, `aria-describedby` and `aria-invalid`.

components.name: Input
components.summary: A single-line input.

components.name: InputGroup
components.summary: An input with something fixed before or after it.

components.name: Textarea
components.summary: A multi-line input. It grows with its text where the browser can.

components.name: NativeSelect
components.summary: The browser's `<select>`.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: A checkbox.

components.name: Switch
components.summary: An on and off switch: a checkbox with the `switch` role.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.summary: One choice out of several, shown: a `fieldset` of native radios, whose keyboard is the browser's.

components.name: Forms
components.summary: Draws a `Form`: a `<form>` that posts with or without the runtime.

components.name: Card
components.summary: A surface for related content.

components.name: Badge
components.summary: A short label beside something.

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: A picture of a person: an image, or a neutral icon when there is none. There is no way to put initials in it.

components.name: Item
components.summary: A row with a title, a description, and things at either end.

components.name: Heading and Text
components.summary: A heading. The level is the document's, the look follows it.

components.name: Kbd
components.summary: A key on the keyboard.

components.name: Attachment
components.summary: A file shown as a small tile.

components.name: Message and Bubble
components.summary: A message in a conversation: who, when, and bubbles.

components.name: Alert
components.summary: A message inside the page.

components.name: Empty
components.summary: What a list shows when it has nothing in it.

components.name: Progress
components.summary: How far along something is: the browser's `<progress>`.

components.name: Skeleton
components.summary: A placeholder while content loads.

components.name: Spinner
components.summary: A sign that something is happening, named for assistive technology.

components.name: Dialog
components.summary: A modal dialog: the browser's `<dialog>`, which brings the focus trap, Esc, focus return and the inert page behind it.

components.name: AlertDialog
components.summary: A dialog that must be answered: `alertdialog`, no close button, and a click outside doesn't dismiss it. Esc still cancels, as APG asks.

components.name: Sheet
components.summary: A dialog that slides in from an edge.

components.name: Drawer
components.summary: A dialog that rises from the bottom, for phones.

components.name: Popover
components.summary: A popup with a click-outside and Esc dismissal, from the browser's `popover`, opened by a button.

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: A short description on hover and on focus, with the `tooltip` role.

components.name: HoverCard
components.summary: A popup on hover or focus with more about a link. Sighted mouse users get it; the same content must be reachable another way.

components.name: Stack, Row, Grid and Container
components.summary: Items one above the other.

components.name: Accordion
components.summary: Sections that open and close: `<details>`, whose keyboard is the browser's. With `exclusive`, one open at a time through `name`.

components.name: Collapsible
components.summary: One section that opens and closes.

components.name: ScrollArea
components.summary: A scrolling region with thin scrollbars, reachable by keyboard.

components.name: Separator
components.summary: A line between things.

components.name: AspectRatio
components.summary: Content held to a shape. The ratios are a closed set because the content security policy allows no `style` attribute.

components.name: Direction
components.summary: Sets the reading direction of what's inside.

components.name: App shell
components.summary: The app's one shell definition. Register it as a provider so `AppShell` can find it.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.summary: Where this page sits: a list of links, ending in the current page.

components.name: Pagination
components.summary: Links between the pages of a list.

components.name: Table
components.summary: A table of data. The wrapper scrolls on narrow screens.

components.name: DataTable
components.summary: A table with search, filters, sort links, selection and pagination, as one region.

components.name: Stat and Bars
components.summary: One figure and what it is.

components.name: Foundations
components.summary: A control's size.

components.name: Commands
components.summary: One browser-side command.

components.name: Regions
components.summary: A named part of a page that updates by itself: fetched after paint, polled, or refetched when an op invalidates it. Its answer morphs in.

examples.code:
let shell = Shell::new("Acme CRM")
    .context("Production")
    .group(
        NavGroup::new("Sales")
            .item(NavItem::new("Overview", "/").icon(icons::LAYOUT_DASHBOARD))
            .item(
                NavItem::new("Deals", "/deals")
                    .icon(icons::HANDSHAKE)
                    .count("312"),
            )
            .item(NavItem::new("Contacts", "/contacts").icon(icons::USERS))
            .item(
                NavItem::new("Reports", "/reports")
                    .icon(icons::CHART_COLUMN)
                    .sub(NavItem::new("Pipeline", "/reports/pipeline"))
                    .sub(NavItem::new("Forecast", "/reports/forecast")),
            ),
    )
    .group(
        NavGroup::new("Workspace")
            .item(NavItem::new("Settings", "/settings").icon(icons::SETTINGS)),
    )
    .user(
        UserMenu::new("Ada Lovelace", "ada@example.com")
            .link("Profile", "/profile")
            .action("Sign out", "/sign-out"),
    );
shell
    .page("Deals", "/deals")
    .actions(
        Button::primary("New deal")
            .icon(icons::PLUS)
            .href("/deals/new"),
    )
    .body(Grid::cols(3).gap(4).children((
        Stat::new("Open deals", "312").trend("+12 this week", true),
        Stat::new("Pipeline value", "$4.2M").trend("+3.1%", true),
        Stat::new("Won this month", "$640K").trend("-2.4%", false),
    )))

examples.title: A data table
A data table
Selection and bulk actions
Filters under the headers
Compact rows
Empty, loading and failed
examples.code:
let query = TableQuery::<Deal>::parse("/deals", "");
let none: Vec<Deal> = Vec::new();
vec![
    (
        "No rows",
        DataTable::new("empty", &query, &none)
            .caption("Deals")
            .empty(Empty::new("No deals yet").icon(icons::INBOX))
            .into(),
    ),
    (
        "Loading",
        DataTable::new("loading", &query, &none)
            .caption("Deals")
            .loading()
            .into(),
    ),
    (
        "Failed",
        DataTable::new("failed", &query, &none)
            .caption("Deals")
            .failed("The deals couldn't be loaded. Try again in a minute.")
            .into(),
    ),
]
